score.note: The recollection largely restates the title: ink-extrusion printing, silicide coating, and generic high-temperature improvement. It omits the hydrogen de-binding and 1400°C/18 h vacuum sintering, sequential hydride decomposition, oxygen strengthening and BCC stabilization, self-healing oxide mechanism, and all quantitative results.
